page.overview:
What is Dark Amulet?

The Dark Amulet is an artifact once owned by the wizard Dreygar in the Western Domains of Dominaria.

A Force of Nature summoned by Dreygar held the artifact, and when the force was destroyed by Aldon, Aldon took it. Aldon later used the artifact's store of black mana to summon a vampire, bog wraith, and frozen shade.
